warm_start_provenance.provenance_limit: Artifact tensor shapes/dtypes, checkpoint, available revision, source runtime and exact frozen head match; the source artifact has no full-prefix checksum

manifest.warm_start_note: Transferred native tail weights to a new task/data run; Adam and step counters restart from zero. This is not same-data continuation.
manifest.whole_vs_split_note: With transferred or continued weights this includes prior learning, not only runtime differences
manifest.runtime: compiled frozen source states + eager BF16 math-SDPA native tail
manifest.optimizer: FP32-master AdamW, separate condition gradients accumulated in FP32, zero decay, gradient norm clip1
manifest.selection: fixed step count; reporting validation does not select checkpoints

intervals.scope: Pointwise, conditional on this prompt bank and one training seed; not simultaneous bands or family-population uncertainty
intervals.accuracy_boundary: An all-correct empirical cohort yields [1,1]; this is not certainty about population accuracy

status_source: explicit CLI annotation; see archived runner evidence
